Q198.reason: Human genetic material is DNA, which stands for deoxyribonucleic acid; the name has nothing to do with nitrogen or nitro groups.

Q199.reason: A pleural friction rub can be heard in both expiration and inspiration, whereas crackles are inspiratory only.

Q200.reason: Somatic cells are diploid, carrying two copies of each of the 23 chromosome pairs, for 46 in total.
